config.fallback: output-NN: the uncovered token takes the covered token whose length-1 next-token distribution is most similar, one neighbour (§1780/§1781)
config.direct: the prediction IS the token's (or its neighbour's) length-1 logit row; no forward through the substituted model at all

config.cost: direct stores 5419 x 50304 = 272.6M reals; composed stores 224.778M at full rank and 15.223M at rank 64. This is a FIDELITY comparison; the direct arm is not a frontier point.
